title: itembank update manifest
description: updates/current.json -- the one pointer file the updater writes after every completed release check, whether or not that check found a newer version. It names the version and artifact this installation currently trusts, and when that trust was last verified against GitHub, so should_check() can rate-limit background checks without a second file.

schema_version.description: This document's own schema version, so a future format change can be told apart from a malformed file.

version.description: The version string (plain vX.Y.Z) of the artifact this manifest points at -- the currently running version until an update lands a newer one.

path.description: Path to the artifact, relative to update_root(). Never the currently-running file's own path when a newer artifact has been downloaded beside it (Success Criterion 3).

sha256.description: The artifact's sha256 hex digest, verified against the release's checksum before this manifest was written.

checked_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the release check that produced this manifest. should_check() reads this to decide whether a new check is due.
